FUNCTION ZSE_READ_CID.

*"----------------------------------------------------------------------

*"*"Interfaccia locale:

*"  IMPORTING

*"     VALUE(INBOUND) TYPE  CHAR30 OPTIONAL

*"  EXPORTING

*"     VALUE(OUTBOUND) TYPE  CHAR30

*"  TABLES

*"      TAB_FILTER STRUCTURE  ZSE_FILTER_STRUCT

*"      TAB_CID STRUCTURE  ZSE_EMPLOYEE_STRUCT

*"----------------------------------------------------------------------



*----------------------------------------------------------------------*

* Dichiarazione dei dati locali alla funzione                          *

*----------------------------------------------------------------------*







  DATA: dim TYPE i.

  DATA: l_sname LIKE pa0001-sname.

  DATA: wa_filter TYPE zse_filter_struct.





*==> Inizializzazione

REFRESH tab_cid_output.



*----------------------------------------------------------------------*

* Blocco di controllo                                                  *

*----------------------------------------------------------------------*



  DESCRIBE TABLE tab_cid LINES dim.



  IF dim > 0.



    LOOP AT tab_filter INTO wa_filter.



      SELECT SINGLE pernr sname FROM pa0001 INTO

       (wa_cid_output-pernr , l_sname)

      WHERE pernr = wa_filter-value

        AND begda <= sy-datum

        AND endda >= sy-datum.



      IF sy-subrc = 0.



       SPLIT l_sname AT space

                     INTO wa_cid_output-nachn

                          wa_cid_output-vorna.

       APPEND wa_cid_output TO tab_cid_output.



      ENDIF.





    ENDLOOP.





  ELSE.



LOOP AT tab_filter INTO wa_filter.



       SELECT SINGLE pernr sname FROM pa0001 INTO

       (wa_cid_output-pernr , l_sname)

      WHERE pernr = wa_filter-value

ENDFORM.

*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*&      Form  CHECK-PERNR
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*       text
*----------------------------------------------------------------------*
*  -->  p1        text
*  <--  p2        text
*----------------------------------------------------------------------*
FORM check-pernr .
  DATA: l_pernr LIKE <wa_tab>-pernr,
        l_data  LIKE sy-datum.

  IF <wa_tab>-begda IS INITIAL.
    l_data = sy-datum.
  ELSE.
    l_data = <wa_tab>-begda.
  ENDIF.

  SELECT SINGLE pernr
    FROM pa0001
    INTO l_pernr
    WHERE pernr = <wa_tab>-pernr
     AND endda >= l_data
     AND begda <= l_data.

  IF NOT sy-subrc IS INITIAL.
    PERFORM add-msg-to-log USING 'E' '000' <wa_tab>-pernr.
    fl_errore = 'X'.
  ENDIF.
ENDFORM.

*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*&      Form  EXIT
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
FORM exit .
  DATA: l_okcode LIKE sy-ucomm.

  l_okcode = va_okcode.
  CLEAR va_okcode.

  CASE l_okcode.
    WHEN ca_exit OR ca_back OR ca_canc.
      CALL METHOD grid1->free.
      CALL METHOD g_custom_container->free.

      CALL METHOD cl_gui_cfw=>flush.

      CLEAR g_custom_container.
      CLEAR grid1.
      CLEAR gr_event_handler.

      SET SCREEN 0.
      LEAVE SCREEN.
  ENDCASE.
ENDFORM.

*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*&      Form  FCODE
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
FORM fcode .
  DATA: l_okcode LIKE sy-ucomm.

  l_okcode = va_okcode.
  CLEAR va_okcode.

  CASE l_okcode.
    WHEN ca_change.
      PERFORM ctr-update.

FUNCTION zse_read_occupational_data.

*"----------------------------------------------------------------------

*"*"Interfaccia locale:

*"  IMPORTING

*"     VALUE(CID) TYPE  PERSNO

*"  TABLES

*"      TAB_OCCUPATIONAL STRUCTURE  ZSE_S_OCCUPATIONAL_DATA

*"----------------------------------------------------------------------

*



**************************

* Dich. var. e tab. int. *

**************************



  DATA: app_persk TYPE pa0001-persk.

  DATA: wa_occupational TYPE zse_s_occupational_data,

          v_gbdat0 TYPE d,

          v_gbdat1 TYPE i,

          id_famiglia_prof TYPE sobid,

          des_famiglia_prof(40),

          id_area_prof TYPE sobid,

          des_area_prof(40),

          app_ztrfar TYPE pa0000-ztrfar.





  TABLES: hrp1001, hrp1000, t001, t527x, t500p, pa0001, t001p.





******************************************************************

*        Lettura CID, Societ�, Area del Personale, Posizione,    *

*        Mansione, Unit� organizzativa da PA0001.                *

******************************************************************



IF NOT CID IS INITIAL.





  SELECT SINGLE pernr bukrs werks btrtl plans stell orgeh persk

  INTO (wa_occupational-pernr,

        wa_occupational-bukrs,

        wa_occupational-werks,

        wa_occupational-btrtl,

        wa_occupational-plans,

        wa_occupational-stell,

        wa_occupational-orgeh,

        app_persk)



  FROM pa0001

  WHERE pernr = cid

  AND begda <= sy-datum

  AND endda => sy-datum.



*******************************************

* Cod. e descr. sottoarea del personale   *

*******************************************

SELECT pernr subty endda begda seqnr
       beguz enduz awart stdaz docnr faprs
  INTO (tb_output-pernr, subty, endda_a, begda_a,
        seqnr, tb_output-beguz, tb_output-enduz,
        tb_output-awart, tb_output-stdaz, tb_output-docnr, va_faprs)
  FROM  pa2002
  WHERE  pernr  IN so_pernr
  AND    subty  IN ra_awart
  AND    sprps  = space
  AND    endda  GE begda
  AND    begda  LE endda
  AND    faprs  IN so_faprs
  ORDER BY awart.

    CHECK: tb_output-pernr IN ra_pernr,
           begda_a IN so_perio AND endda_a IN so_perio.

    REFRESH ptext.
    CONCATENATE: tb_output-pernr '2002' subty INTO key1,
                 endda_a begda_a seqnr INTO key2,
                 key1 key2 INTO final_key SEPARATED BY blank1.
    MOVE final_key TO tx-key.
    rp-imp-c1-tx.
    LOOP AT ptext.
      IF sy-tabix EQ 1.
        tb_output-tipon = ptext.
      ELSE.
        tb_output-note = ptext.
      ENDIF.
    ENDLOOP.

    CHECK tb_output-tipon IN so_tipon.

    MOVE: tb_output-pernr TO tb_testo-pernr,
          subty TO tb_testo-subty,
          endda_a TO tb_testo-endda,
          begda_a TO tb_testo-begda,
          seqnr TO tb_testo-seqnr,
          seqnr TO tb_output-seqnr.
*    APPEND tb_testo.

    SELECT pernr kostl kostl sname
      INTO (tb_output-pernr, tb_output-kostl,
            tb_output-kostl_o, tb_output-sname)
      FROM  pa0001
      WHERE  pernr  = tb_output-pernr
      AND    sprps  = space
      AND    endda  GE begda_a
      AND    begda  LE endda_a
      AND    werks  IN so_werks
      AND    persg  IN so_persg
      AND    persk  IN so_persk
      AND    btrtl  IN so_btrtl
      AND    kostl  IN so_kostl
      AND    orgeh  IN so_orgeh
      ORDER BY pernr.

ra_pernr-low = tb_pernr_aut-pernr.
      APPEND ra_pernr.
    ENDLOOP.

    LOOP AT tb_t77pr.
      AT FIRST.
        ra_objid = 'IEQ'.
      ENDAT.

      ra_objid-low = tb_t77pr-objid.
      APPEND ra_objid.
    ENDLOOP.

    LOOP AT so_pernr.
      IF NOT so_pernr-low IN ra_pernr.
        SELECT SINGLE * FROM  pa0001
          WHERE  pernr  = so_pernr-low
          AND    sprps  = space
*        AND    endda  = '99991231'
          AND    endda  GE begda
          AND    begda  LE endda
          AND    orgeh  IN ra_objid.
        IF sy-subrc EQ 0.
          ra_pernr = 'IEQ'.
          ra_pernr-low = so_pernr-low.
          APPEND ra_pernr.
        ENDIF.
      ENDIF.
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDIF.                               "INS SC_04/05/2015

  so_persg = 'EEQ'.
  so_persg-low = '2'.
  APPEND so_persg.

  SELECT pernr kostl sname
    INTO CORRESPONDING FIELDS OF TABLE tb_pernr
    FROM  pa0001
    WHERE  pernr  IN so_pernr
    AND    pernr  IN ra_pernr
    AND    sprps  EQ space
    AND    endda  GE begda
    AND    begda  LE endda
    AND    werks  IN so_werks
    AND    persg  IN so_persg
    AND    persk  IN so_persk
    AND    btrtl  IN so_btrtl
    AND    orgeh  IN so_orgeh
    ORDER BY pernr.

  DELETE ADJACENT DUPLICATES FROM tb_pernr COMPARING pernr.

  IF fl_n IS INITIAL.                                 "INS SC_04/05/2015
* Inizio modifiche                       "INS SC_01/07/2014
    DATA: persk TYPE persk,
          cod_ogg_ext LIKE pa0001-cod_ogg_ext,
          orgeh LIKE pa0001-orgeh,
          sobid LIKE hrp1001-sobid,
          codice_uo TYPE char20,
          profl LIKE tb_persk-profl,
          fl_nok.

REFRESH: tb_output_appo, tb_output.

  SELECT pernr begda endda kostl kostl sname
    INTO (tb_output-pernr, tb_output-begda,
          tb_output-endda, tb_output-kostl,
          tb_output-kostl_o, tb_output-sname)
    FROM  pa0001
    WHERE  pernr  IN so_pernr
    AND    sprps  = space
    AND    endda  GE begda
    AND    begda  LE endda
    AND    werks  IN so_werks
    AND    persg  IN so_persg
    AND    persk  IN so_persk
    AND    btrtl  IN so_btrtl
    AND    kostl  IN so_kostl
    AND    orgeh  IN so_orgeh.

    CHECK tb_output-pernr IN ra_pernr.

    MOVE-CORRESPONDING tb_output TO tb_output_appo.
    APPEND tb_output_appo.

  ENDSELECT.

  LOOP AT tb_output_appo.
    AT NEW pernr.
      REFRESH tb_datum.
    ENDAT.

    MOVE-CORRESPONDING tb_output_appo TO tb_output.
    IF tb_output-begda LT begda.
      tb_output-begda = begda.
    ENDIF.
    IF tb_output-endda GT endda.
      tb_output-endda = endda.
    ENDIF.

    REFRESH: zes, psp.

    b2_key-pernr = tb_output-pernr.
    b2_key-pabrj = tb_output-begda+0(4).
    b2_key-pabrp = tb_output-begda+4(2).
    b2_key-cltyp = '1'.
    IMPORT psp zes FROM DATABASE pcl2(b2) ID b2_key.

    SELECT SINGLE zzawart INTO zzawart
      FROM  ztm_straord_fond
      WHERE  zzktart  = pa_fondo
      AND    zzbegda  LE tb_output-endda
      AND    zzendda  GE tb_output-begda.

refresh: tb_output_appo, tb_output.

*** AG - Inizio
  clear: tb_output_appo, tb_output , tb_quonr , tb_quonr[], seqnr.
***AG - Fine

  select pernr begda endda kostl kostl sname
    into (tb_output-pernr, tb_output-begda,
          tb_output-endda, tb_output-kostl,
          tb_output-kostl_o, tb_output-sname)
    from  pa0001
    where  pernr  in so_pernr
    and    sprps  = space
    and    endda  ge begda
    and    begda  le endda
    and    werks  in so_werks
    and    persg  in so_persg
    and    persk  in so_persk
    and    btrtl  in so_btrtl
    and    kostl  in so_kostl
    and    orgeh  in so_orgeh.

    check tb_output-pernr in ra_pernr.

          cod_ogg_ext like pa0001-cod_ogg_ext,
          orgeh       like pa0001-orgeh,
          sobid       like hrp1001-sobid,
          codice_uo   type char20,
          profl       like tb_persk-profl,
          fl_nok.

    if is_authorized is initial.
      select single persk orgeh
        into (persk, orgeh)

        where  pernr  = tb_output-pernr

      if sy-subrc eq 0.
